description: Illustrative minimal instance of kye.sweep_artefact_classes.v1 (§0.18 example slot), carrying two OSS-track corpora. The canonical registry is IP-track and declares the full class set; it is deliberately NOT mirrored here. An earlier draft did mirror it, on the reasoning that a fictional corpus would be a second drifting description of the contract — which put five IP-track paths onto a public surface (§33 / Hard rule #1). The right resolution is a REAL but PUBLIC corpus: the shape stays honest, the IP/OSS line holds, and neither is traded for the other. Note the prose must observe the same line as the data — the first rewrite of this field named the internal root while explaining why not to, and the scanner caught it.

classes.description: The -canonical gate family. A gate is an artefact under §0.18 like any other: it must be registered, not merely present on disk.
Every public site surface. Shows the two-field match contract at its simplest — a suffix rule, no exclusion — against a corpus that is itself public.
